title: AdvWave: Stealthy Adversarial Jailbreak Attack against Large Audio-Language Models

layout.note: Two tinted halves side by side: warm cream Phase II on the left, cool grey-blue Phase I on the right, each with a bold underlined title at the bottom. The audio encoder and the tokenization module sit at the top, across the left half and the boundary, as a shared pipeline; the loss rows and text samples fill the lower parts. A long line ties one cluster dot to a dashed circle beside L_align.

lesson: Give each optimisation phase its own tinted half with a bold title, let the shared modules straddle the boundary, and write each loss as a bold symbol on dashed arrows between the two things it compares; colour the sample texts red and green to mark target and refusal.
